verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor (hardware), and scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a software or OS capability, not something buyers ask of a CPU. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip or its first-party tooling ships any job or workflow scheduler. The cited items cover AI engines, the NPU, OpenVINO/oneAPI developer tools and vPro manageability, none of which is a recurring scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
